title: OneDrive: build and share agents from OneDrive files, with .agent files retiring after March 2027
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's guidance supports the March 2027 retirement, owner-led upgrades, licensing requirement and blocking limitations. The automation notes should name the request-body settings, and the sharing path needs an additional supporting citation.
